title: ChangeOfRingsTensorActionMapsActions
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], B and C sheaves of commutative O_Y-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], phi:B to C an algebra morphism, and P a sheaf of B-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Set P0=P restricted to O_Y and S=C.toModule tensor_O P0 [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. There exist O_Y-module morphisms a,d:B.toModule tensor_O S to S whose values on b tensor (c tensor p) are respectively c tensor bp and phi(b)c tensor p, for every open W and sections b,c,p.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 01SB (morphisms-lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), change of rings assertion; Sheaves, Lemma 0089 (sheaves-lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules); explicit tensor-balancing argument in steps 1-4 of lem-weil-pbc-change-of-rings-tensor-relation-presentation

proof.text: Construct a presheaf morphism from a natural O_Y-bilinear pairing by the sectionwise tensor universal property. Extend it through sheafification using its adjunction; the unit equation gives its value on pure tensors.

Apply this construction to (b,p) ↦ b • p and (b,c) ↦ phi(b)c. Bilinearity follows from commutativity, mul_smul, and the equation B.hom ≫ phi.right = C.hom. Naturality follows from the module restriction scalar law and naturality of phi.

Define a as inverse associator, braiding on B tensor C, associator, and id_C tensor act. Define d as inverse associator followed by mul tensor id_P. TensorSection computes all these maps on pure tensor sections, yielding the required two formulas.

theorem exists_changeOfRings_tensor_action_maps_actions (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right)) :
    ∃ (a d : tensorObj B.toModule (tensorObj C.toModule
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)) ⟶
      tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)),
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
        (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        a.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
            (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
            (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) c (b • p)) ∧
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
        (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        d.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
            (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule)
            (N := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)
            (φ.right.hom.app (op W) b * c) p)
